note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: AI stocks hammered by midterm shock as data center buildout becomes 'war of attrition'
items.blurb: Nvidia fell 9.3% and AMD 17.3% after Democrats won Congress, raising doubts about the planned U.S. data center buildout.

items.title: OpenAI will keep investing in AI data centers despite election results, CFO tells CNBC
items.blurb: OpenAI's finance chief says the midterm results do not change its infrastructure plans, despite investor fears of a buildout slowdown.

items.title: Trump says voters should blame themselves for stock market rout
items.blurb: The president blamed Democratic voters for the AI-led selloff, as the data center buildout becomes a partisan fight.

items.title: OpenAI pledges to halt NDAs in new data center policy proposal after election rebuke
items.blurb: OpenAI promises community input, public construction plans and full power-cost coverage, and asks lawmakers to make such commitments law.

items.title: How the midterms could fuel the K-shaped AI trade
items.blurb: Stricter state data-center oversight could favor hyperscalers with existing capacity over debt-funded neoclouds, mostly from 2028.

items.title: The Download: Texas's fragile AI boom and energy policy shifts
items.blurb: Texas, the fastest-growing US data-center market, faces new uncertainty as the Senate prepares a Nov 9 energy vote.

items.title: Jim Cramer says the AI trade is not going away as Nasdaq enters correction
items.blurb: The Nasdaq is more than 10% below its October record as investors fear financing and political limits on AI data centers.

items.title: China's Moonshot AI sought Nvidia chip access in Europe amid U.S. curbs
items.blurb: Moonshot reportedly sought to rent 8,000-plus Blackwell GPUs in Europe, testing export rules that do not yet cover cloud access.

items.title: Expedia CEO says AI agents aren't changing booking habits — yet
items.blurb: Expedia sees AI agents helping travelers plan trips but not yet changing how they book.

items.title: Voters rejected data centers over resource fears. Why measuring water use is hard
items.blurb: Water use drove voter opposition to data centers, yet companies report it inconsistently, making the real burden hard to measure.

items.title: Dow tumbles 1,500 points, erasing its postelection rally; Nasdaq plummets 5%
items.blurb: Chip and data-center stocks led a broad selloff on fears the Democratic sweep slows the AI buildout and adds regulation.

items.title: AI meltdown: Nvidia and Qualcomm drop more than 9%, pushing Nasdaq to worst day since April 2025
items.blurb: Chipmakers led a broad AI selloff as investors weighed slower data-center building after the midterms and a weak Qualcomm forecast.

items.title: Top Democrats call to rein in AI buildout after midterms sweep: 'National data center moratorium now'
items.blurb: Sen. Bernie Sanders and other Democrats push data-center limits, signaling tougher federal scrutiny of the AI buildout next year.

items.title: Tech giants turn to cash, concessions for AI rebrand after voters pummeled data centers 43-1
items.blurb: After local ballot defeats, Amazon pledged $1 billion for data-center communities and OpenAI published a community-benefits blueprint.

items.title: OpenAI's new cyber model found ways to attack nearly 1000 Linux flaws
items.blurb: OpenAI's gated GPT-6 Cyber built working exploits for 948 Linux bugs, sharpening debate over who should get offensive AI tools.

items.title: Stock futures fall after Nasdaq correction; Japan's Nikkei 225 enters bear market
items.blurb: The AI chip selloff spread to Asia, where Korea's Kospi fell over 8% and triggered a trading halt.

items.title: Nvidia's Huang is asked to brief Congress on reported Chinese spy relationship
items.blurb: Three House committee chairs requested a closed-door Nov 18 briefing on Huang's ties to a Megaspeed executive.

items.title: Neocloud IREN says $4 billion in annualized revenue being delayed by customer request
items.blurb: A major AI cloud provider pushed $4 billion of expected revenue to January, adding to doubts over neocloud financing.

items.title: AI data center stocks and Musk's SpaceX decline as Texas governor result raises risks of a slowdown
items.blurb: Texas elected a governor who backs a data center moratorium, threatening a state holding much of planned US AI capacity.

items.title: Palantir stock slumps on good numbers, as investors get choosy
items.blurb: Palantir beat estimates and raised guidance, yet shares fell, a sign investors are growing selective about AI winners.

items.title: OpenAI targets Microsoft's GitHub with deal for startup
items.blurb: OpenAI will buy Pierre Computer, whose developer tools already run inside Codex, putting it closer to competing with GitHub.

items.title: Voters revolt against AI buildout and tech titans at ballot box
items.blurb: About two dozen local measures restricting or blocking data centers appeared to pass across 10 states in the midterms.

items.title: Elon Musk's record election bet backfired. The backlash may reach beyond one billionaire
items.blurb: Musk spent at least $474 million on the midterms; his Texas candidates lost amid a backlash against billionaires and AI.

items.title: Texas was the new epicenter of the AI data center buildout. That might be kaput.
items.blurb: Texas Democrats won the governorship and state House; the governor-elect wants a data center moratorium that could hit Stargate-scale sites.
